mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_documents (title, content, toc_json, file_type, original_file_url, preview_pdf_path, ocr_raw_json, dify_document_id, dify_sync_status, category, tags, status, enabled, version, is_latest, published_at, expired_at, archived_at, archive_reason, reviewed_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{tocJson}, #{fileType}, #{originalFileUrl}, #{previewPdfPath}, #{ocrRawJson}, #{difyDocumentId}, #{difySyncStatus}, #{category}, #{tags}, #{status}, #{enabled}, #{version}, #{isLatest}, #{publishedAt}, #{expiredAt}, #{archivedAt}, #{archiveReason}, #{reviewedBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_documents WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM knowledge_documents ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM knowledge_documents WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM knowledge_documents WHERE status IN #{s} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM knowledge_documents WHERE category = #{category} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_documents WHERE category = #{category} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND enabled = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_documents SET category = '' WHERE category = #{category}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_documents WHERE dify_document_id = #{difyDocumentId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_documents WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT FROM knowledge_documents WHERE status = #{status} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT FROM knowledge_documents WHERE status = 'PENDING_REVIEW'
AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND category = #{category}
ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_documents WHERE dify_sync_status = #{difySyncStatus}
SELECT category AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM knowledge_documents WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND enabled = 1 GROUP BY category ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, review_started_at, reviewed_at)) FROM knowledge_documents WHERE reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy} AND review_started_at IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'ARCHIVED') AND reviewed_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT DATE(updated_at) AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approvedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ARCHIVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejectedCount FROM knowledge_documents WHERE reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy} AND status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'ARCHIVED') AND updated_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(updated_at) ORDER BY statDate

SELECT id AS documentId, title, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS reviewedAt, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, review_started_at, reviewed_at) AS reviewDurationSeconds, status AS reviewResult, reviewed_by AS reviewedBy FROM knowledge_documents WHERE status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'ARCHIVED') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
